name: mom
description: Node.js and SYCL miner built on XMRig hashing sources with MoneroOcean algo switching support
author: MoneroOcean contributors

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:logic: node --require ./tests/common/no_pool_network.js --test tests/logic.js tests/compiler_policy.js tests/nvidia_compatibility.js tests/readme_performance.js tests/benchmark_scripts.js tests/windows_command.js tests/pool_transport.js tests/helper_workers.js tests/release_archive.js
scripts.test:github: npm run check && npm run test:gpu-foundations && npm run test:xelishashv3-ops && npm run test:zhash-ref && npm run test:equihash192-ref && npm run test:nexapow-ref && npm run test:octopus-ref && npm run test:c30-ref && npm run test:hoohash-ref && npm run test:pearlhash-ref && npm run test:pearlhash-claim && npm run test:logic
scripts.test:xelishashv3-ops: out=/tmp/mom-xelishashv3-ops-$$; trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT; for xelis_flags in '' '-DMOM_SYCL_PORTABLE_OPENCL'; do c++ -std=c++20 -O2 $xelis_flags tests/logic/xelishashv3_operations.cpp -o "$out" && "$out" || exit; done
scripts.test:c30-ref: out=/tmp/mom-c30-ref-$$; trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT; c++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -I xmrig tests/reference/c30_cortex.cpp xmrig/crypto/randomx/blake2/blake2b.c xmrig/base/crypto/keccak.cpp -o "$out" && "$out"
